shared_elements: low-relief carving on a standing stone/pillar surface
row of repeated arch- or U-shaped motifs across the upper zone
horizontal band or register dividing the composition
animal/creature figures in profile below the band
schematic, flattened relief with rounded outlines
justification: Both surfaces show a tall standing block carved in low relief with a horizontal register system: an upper row of repeated arch/U-shaped motifs (three in B, comparable paired loops/arcs at the top of A) above a banded divider, with rounded schematic forms below, including a prominent disc-like element. The differences are substantial in the lower zone: B shows distinct profile creatures (bird-like and quadruped/reptile forms) with a fringed or toothed band, whereas A's body is dominated by an anthropomorphic pillar-figure with abstract bosses, a large concentric disc and belt-like arcs rather than identifiable animals.
